headline: Land Permits of 338,536 Hectares Revoked, Here Is the Owner of PT RAPP
summary: The Indonesian government has revoked the permit of PT RAPP over environmental violations in Riau. The permit covers 338,536 hectares.
why: PT RAPP is a major pulp and paper producer in Riau, Sumatra, and its forest concessions are key to its raw material supply. Permit revocations can disrupt output and affect pulp and paper supply chains.

entities.name: PT Riau Andalan Pulp and Paper (RAPP)

original_headline: Izin Lahan 338.536 Hektare Dicabut, Ini Pemilik PT RAPP
